8. 9. 36. 8 - 9 - 36

My dear Robertson,

Mr. Arturo de Carvalho, a well known
local dentist and photographer, left Shanghai for India
some months ago. According to his statement he has
some connections with the French firm "de la Rue". I
should be grateful for any information you can give me
as to why this individual went to India and if you could
confirm his statement.

Yours Sincerely,

T. Robertson Esq.,
Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

DS Pitts

亲爱的罗伯逊：

SUSPECTS AND UNDESIRABLES

Para. 2/37. CARVALHO, Dr. Don Arturo.

Now in Rangoon. Passport No. 11332, 1st February, 1935, Shanghai. Doubtful morals
enthusiastic photographer of "peeping tom" variety. Collects money fraudulently on the
plea of collecting material and photographs for an album of Indian Princes for presentation
to the King during the Coronation.

Should be kept under unobtrusive surveillance. (Burma Police Abstract Volume XI,
No. 8 and D.S.B. 1643/27/4 refer).

嫌疑人与不受欢迎人物

第 2/37 段。卡瓦略，阿图罗·唐博士（CARVALHO, Dr. Don Arturo）。

现居仰光。护照号码 11332，1935年2月1日签发于上海。品行可疑，热衷于“偷窥狂”式的摄影。以收集素材和照片为借口进行欺诈性敛财，声称要制作一本印度王公相册，在加冕典礼期间献给国王。

应对其进行隐蔽监视。（参见缅甸警察摘要第十一卷，第8号，以及 D.S.B. 1643/27/4）。

Subject Communication dated September 8, 1936 from H.B.M. Consulate-General
regarding Dr. Arturo Alfred de CARVALHO.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

The real reason for Dr. Arturo Alfred de CARVALHO's
departure from Shanghai for India in the autumn of 1935 was
one of financial embarrassment. He was so heavily in debt
to many individuals and companies in Shanghai, that he event-
ually found himself in such straits that he considered it ex-
pedient to leave this city, his creditors unpaid and unsatis-
fied. A certain local private detective agency is still
vainly endeavouring to collect outstanding monies from him.

de Carvalho proceeded to Bombay where his forwarding
address is understood to be:
c/o Imperial Bank of India,
Head Office,
Bombay.

According to information received, de Carvalho has
ingratiated himself into the good offices of an extremely
high Indian ruling dignitary, who able to appreciate the
undoubted skill of de Carvalho's photographic ability has
given him carte-blanche to take various pictures of his state
and followers for purposes of reproduction to be used at the
forthcoming coronation ceremonies of King Edward VIII.

That de Carvalho is now comparatively well off cannot
be doubted, as enquiries show that he has remitted by cable
various sums of money to Shanghai in order that certain of
his relatives may join him. One niece and two nephews have
already proceeded to Bombay.

de Carvalho was not officially connected with the
British company of Thos. de la Rue & Co. Ltd., but he was
on terms of friendship with A.J. Avramow, the Far Eastern
manager of this concern, as a result of which, he photographed

事由：英国驻上海总领事馆1936年9月8日关于阿图罗·阿尔弗雷德·德·卡瓦略博士（Dr. Arturo Alfred de CARVALHO）的公函。

由副警探 Pitts 制作。由警司 J. Boyne 转呈。

阿图罗·阿尔弗雷德·德·卡瓦略博士于1935年秋季离开上海前往印度的真正原因是经济窘迫。他在上海欠下许多个人和公司的巨额债务，最终陷入困境，认为在未偿还债权人债务、未满足其要求的情况下离开本市是权宜之计。某家本地私人侦探社仍在徒劳地试图向他追讨欠款。

德·卡瓦略前往孟买，据悉他的转交地址为：
印度帝国银行代收，
总行，
孟买。

根据收到的情报，德·卡瓦略已讨好了一位地位极高的印度统治权贵，该权贵赏识德·卡瓦略毋庸置疑的摄影技巧，给予他全权许可，拍摄其宫廷及随从的各种照片，用于复制，以便在即将到来的爱德华八世国王加冕典礼上使用。

德·卡瓦略目前生活相当宽裕，这一点毋庸置疑，因为调查显示，他已通过电汇将多笔款项汇至上海，以便其某些亲属前往与他团聚。一名侄女和两名侄子已先期前往孟买。

德·卡瓦略与英国托马斯·德拉鲁有限公司（Thos. de la Rue & Co. Ltd.）并无官方隶属关系，但他与该公司的远东经理 A.J. Avramow 交情甚笃，因此，他为后者拍摄了
